mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over a 6-month horizon signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rises by more than 0.5% in 6 months while S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% over a 3-month horizon signals labor market weakness, which depresses consumer spending and corporate profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE falls below 4.5% while S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 2.5% over a 6-month horizon signals monetary tightening, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS remains below 2.5% while S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 3% annualized growth over a 6-month horizon signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth falls below 3% annualized while S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the producer price index (PPI) below 1% annualized growth over a 6-month horizon signals easing inflationary pressures, which reduces input costs and boosts corporate profit margins, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PPI rises above 1% annualized while S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 monthly growth over a 3-month horizon signals labor market strength, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth falls below 200,000 monthly while S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 1.5% over a 6-month horizon signals monetary easing, which compresses discount rates and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 1.5% while S&P 500 produces positive 20d returns in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the housing starts index (HOUST) below 1,100,000 annualized units over a 6-month horizon signals weakening residential construction activity, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises above 1,100,000 annualized units while S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns in more than 60% of instances.
